comment: Known results of run-kunit.py with aurora.kunitconfig. Keys are suite.test[.param].
results: cases that do not pass, with the status they are expected to have and why.
warnings: kernel splats (WARNING, BUG, ...) inside a case, by call site and count. KTAP still
reports these cases as passed, so they are tracked here; a new or missing one is a mismatch.

apple-dcp-fabric.fabric_scenario_test.S3.reason: Unconditional: scenario 35 of the fabric scenario table only calls kunit_skip("TB match-data retry policy is tested by W3") (drivers/gpu/drm/apple/dcp-fabric-test.c). No other code in the tree is named W3; the retry policy is not exercised by this case.

rust_kernel_kunit.rust_test_kunit_always.reason: By design (upstream Rust KUnit selftest): the case carries #[cfg(not(all()))], so #[kunit_tests] reports it as skipped to show that cfg'd-out tests are not run (rust/kernel/kunit.rs).

trusted_source.trusted_source_after_mark.reason: By design when built in: the case skips while system_state < SYSTEM_RUNNING, because built-in KUnit runs before mark_readonly(). It only runs when trusted_source_kunit is loaded as a module after boot, which kunit.py run does not do (security/keys/trusted-keys/tests/trusted_source_kunit.c).

apple-dcp-external-announce.announce_unb.reason: WARN_ON(!work->func): dcp_comp_unbind() calls disable_work_sync(&dcp->dimensions_wq), which only dcp_modes_init() initialises; the announce test fixture never calls dcp_modes_init(). The test still passes.

apple-dcp-external-announce.announce_shu.reason: Same uninitialised dimensions_wq flush in dcp_comp_unbind().

apple-dcp-external-announce.announce_pro.reason: Same uninitialised dimensions_wq flush in dcp_comp_unbind().

apple-dcp-external-announce.announce_rel.reason: Same uninitialised dimensions_wq flush in dcp_comp_unbind(), once per unbind in the case.

apple-dcp-external-announce.announce_res.reason: Same uninitialised dimensions_wq flush in dcp_comp_unbind(), once per unbind in the case.

apple-dcp-external-announce.announce_new.reason: Same uninitialised dimensions_wq flush in dcp_comp_unbind(), once per unbind in the case.

apple-display-parser.parser_attribute_de.reason: WARN_ON(!list_empty(&work->entry)): dcp_attributes_replace() schedules dcp->connector->hotplug_wq, but the test allocates the connector with kunit_kzalloc() and never calls INIT_WORK() on it, so the work is refused. The test still passes.
